confirmed_scope: Original nested AVaR and unchanged implemented terminal policy are retained; no static-risk or alternative-objective replacement is used.
The mixed modulus is restricted to original d=2 primitives and includes active capacity and risk-region switches.
The exact point-value information upper/lower is scoped to a fixed known risk density; tail location, point accuracy and descendant Bellman work are additional costs.
The nonsmooth adversarial lower class is explicitly distinguished from the extra smoothness and analytic formula access of the original investment economy.
The implemented tail-transfer intersection can improve lower/refusal bounds but does not receive credit for the upper acceptance gate or saved endpoint queries.
Safe refinement is conditional on outward original-policy enclosures and unchanged qualification. The capped ladder is not an optimality certificate.
Population claims concern 48 own-incumbent gain groups under the declared finite dyadic law and conditional independent entropy, with 192 threshold and 48 mean multiplicity accounts.
Critic fitting is unchanged and no action-aware training convergence or neural-exclusive approximation advantage is claimed.
